s_mem.name: Svnapot
s_mem.behavior:
In Sv39, Sv48, and Sv57, when a PTE has N=1, the PTE represents a
translation that is part of a range of contiguous virtual-to-physical
translations with the same values for PTE bits 5-0. Such ranges must be
of a naturally aligned power-of-2 (NAPOT) granularity larger than the
base page size.

s_mem.name: Svade
s_mem.behavior:
The Svade extension indicates that hardware does *not* update the A/D bits of a page table
during a page walk. Rather, encountering a PTE with the A bit clear or the D bit clear when
an operation is a write will cause a Page Fault.

s_mem.name: Svadu
s_mem.long_name: Hardware Updating of PTE A/D Bits

s_mem.name: Svvptc
s_mem.long_name: Guarantee visibility of PTE transitions from invalid to valid
s_mem.behavior:
When the Svvptc extension is implemented, explicit stores by a hart that update
the Valid bit of leaf and/or non-leaf PTEs from 0 to 1 and are visible to a hart
will eventually become visible within a bounded timeframe to subsequent implicit
accesses by that hart to such PTEs.

s_trap.name: Sstvecd
s_trap.behavior:
`stvec.MODE` must be capable of holding the value 0 (Direct).
When `stvec.MODE`=Direct, `stvec.BASE` must be capable of holding any valid
four-byte-aligned address.

s_trap.name: Sstvecv
s_trap.behavior:
`stvec.MODE` must be capable of holding the value 1 (Vectored).
When `stvec.MODE`=Vectored, interrupts set `pc` to `stvec.BASE + 4 * cause`,
allowing each interrupt source to have its own entry point.
Synchronous exceptions still use the base address regardless of the mode.

standard or reserved encoding spaces raises an illegal instruction
exception that results in a contained trap to the supervisor-mode

s_trap.name: Ssu32xl
s_trap.behavior:
`sstatus.UXL` must be capable of holding the value 1 (i.e., UXLEN=32 must be supported).

This allows U-mode to run 32-bit code on a 64-bit machine by setting `sstatus.UXL` to 1.

s_trap.name: Ssu64xl
s_trap.behavior:
`sstatus.UXL` must be capable of holding the value 2 (i.e., UXLEN=64 must be supported).

[NOTE]
This extension is defined by RVA22.

s_trap.name: Ssube
s_trap.behavior:
`sstatus.UBE` must be capable of holding the value 1 (i.e., big-endian user mode must be supported).

When `sstatus.UBE` is set to 1, data accesses in U-mode use big-endian byte ordering.
Instructions are always fetched as little-endian regardless of this setting.

s_trap.behavior:
A machine-level extension that provides pointer masking for the next lower privilege mode
(S/HS if S-mode is implemented, or U-mode otherwise).

s_trap.name: Shgatpa
s_trap.desc: SvNNx4 guest translation for all supported S-mode modes, plus Bare

For each supported virtual memory scheme SvNN supported in

`hgatp` mode Bare must also be supported.

[NOTE]
This extension was ratified with the RVA22 profiles.

s_trap.long_name: Hypervisor Trap Value provides all needed values
s_trap.behavior:

the ISA.

[NOTE]
This extension was ratified with the RVA22 profiles.

[NOTE]
This extension was ratified with the RVA22 profiles.
